'''Jeff Pill''' was a friend of [[Geordi Hans]] and, along with Hans, [[Franklin Scott]], and [[A-B6]], was a member of the [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|gang]] called the [[Farns]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="GG7" />
